n = int(input())
m = int(input())
P = int(input())

def add_modulo(a, b):
    a += b
    if a >= P:
        a -= P
    return a

def multiply(a, b):
    return (a * b) % P

def self_mult(a, b):
    return (a * b) % P

MAX = 511
dwu = [[0] * (MAX) for _ in range(MAX)]
dp1 = [0] * (MAX)
dp2 = [[0] * (MAX) for _ in range(MAX)]
dp3 = [[0] * (MAX) for _ in range(MAX)]
cnt = [0] * (MAX)

for i in range(n + 1):
    for j in range(i + 1):
        if j == 0:
            dwu[i][j] = 1
        else:
            dwu[i][j] = add_modulo(dwu[i - 1][j], dwu[i - 1][j - 1])

dp1[0] = 0
cnt[0] = 1
for i in range(1, m + 1):
    for j in range(i):
        val = 0
        val = add_modulo(val, multiply(dp1[j], cnt[i - j - 1]))
        val = add_modulo(val, multiply(dp1[i - j - 1], cnt[j]))
        val = self_mult(val, j + 1)
        temp = multiply(cnt[i - j - 1], cnt[j])
        temp = self_mult(temp, j * (j + 1) // 2)
        val = add_modulo(val, temp)
        val = self_mult(val, dwu[i - 1][j])
        dp1[i] = add_modulo(dp1[i], val)
        temp = dwu[i - 1][j]
        temp = self_mult(temp, cnt[j])
        temp = self_mult(temp, cnt[i - j - 1])
        temp = self_mult(temp, j + 1)
        cnt[i] = add_modulo(cnt[i], temp)
    cnt[i] = add_modulo(cnt[i], cnt[i])
    dp1[i] = add_modulo(dp1[i], dp1[i])

dp2[0][0] = 1
dp3[0][0] = 0
for i in range(n + 1):
    for j in range(m + 1):
        for k in range(m + 1):
            if j + k <= m and i + k + 1 <= n + 1:
                val = dp2[i][j]
                val = self_mult(val, dwu[m - j][k])
                val = self_mult(val, cnt[k])
                val3 = dp3[i][j]
                val3 = self_mult(val3, cnt[k])
                val3 = add_modulo(val3, multiply(dp1[k], dp2[i][j]))
                val3 = self_mult(val3, dwu[m - j][k])
                dp3[i + k + 1][j + k] = add_modulo(dp3[i + k + 1][j + k], val3)
                dp2[i + k + 1][j + k] = add_modulo(dp2[i + k + 1][j + k], val)

print(dp3[n + 1][m])
